skills.name: Charged Bolt
skills.description:
Fires a charged arrow at an enemy dealing 1181 (919 + 206% Ranged Attack) Ranged Damage and slowing Move Speed for 2.5s.
The skill cannot be evaded, blocked, or parried.
Damage is reduced -20% if the target is within 8m.

skills.name: Boneyard
skills.description:
Inflicts 771 (444 + 257% Ranged Attack) Ranged damage on a target and all surrounding enemies in a 5m radius, confining them in a Bone Prison.
Staggers all affected enemies, briefly stopping movement and canceling all Cast Time and Channeled skills.
The Bone Prison disappears in 10 seconds if not destroyed.

skills.name: Concussive Arrow
skills.description:
Fires an arrow that explodes on contact, dealing 1152 (563 + 463% Ranged Attack) Ranged Damage and Shackling all enemies within 6m of the target for 3.5s. 
Staggers all affected enemies, briefly stopping movement and canceling all Cast Time and Channeled skills.
This skill cannot be evaded, blocked, or parried.

Staggers all affected enemies, briefly stopping movement and canceling all Cast Time and Channeled skills.
This skill cannot be evaded, blocked, or parried.
This skill cannot be used while Snared.

skills.name: Hunting Pack
skills.description:
Summons Snowlion Spectres to charge through enemies in front of you, inflicting 1046 (889 + 123% Ranged Attack) Physical damage and launching them into the air. Any additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing the damage and number of Snowlions.
If cast while at 6 Abyssal Charges, affected enemies are temporarily prevented from using skills.
This skill counts as a Push effect.

skills.name: Serpent's Sight
skills.description:
Enhance your archery with Abyssal magic, transforming your attacks and gaining unparalleled range. Increases the base range of all Bow skills to at least 50m for 5s, but prevents movement.
Replaces Endless Arrows with Fang Bolt for the duration.
Duration resets for every Ranged Attack that hits, but all effects end if the caster receives damage.
